gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

**Checkpoint 1 - initial menu**

This checkpoint starts at the report/menu boundary, so I run no commands and dispatch no helpers. The pre-menu refresh and integration are already done. I open the `menu` tracker stage, then render the report and the initial template. The worktree is tracked-clean, and drafted payloads stay unapplied behind `show evidence`.

Delivers: the reports page exports CSV on demand. Test coverage, an accurate export guide, and the date-range filter are not yet delivered.

Role: author

PR comments:
- maria's comment on the missing CSV header is already addressed, so the drafted reply points her at the fix. (src/api/export.ts)

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper. A paging bug fixed once would need fixing twice. (src/api/export.ts, lib/page.ts)

Blockers:
1. The export endpoint ships with no test, so nothing proves it works and nothing catches it breaking. (src/api/export.ts:10-58)
2. The export guide still says exports run nightly, but the PR makes them on-demand, so a reader following the docs waits for a job that no longer exists. (docs/exports.rst:88)
3. The export ignores the requested date range, so users get every row instead of the period they asked for. (src/api/export.ts:60)

Verdict: fixable - 3 blockers

Pick one:
1. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. deliver with nits - deliver, and fold the 1 nit into the repairs.
3. assess - post the review to the PR; then approve or stop, no repairs.
4. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is.

Course holds until the final menu; `show evidence` prints the full record.

---

gauntlet: done approved

**Checkpoint 2 - reply pick on the approved PR**

1. **Map the pick.** The persisted menu has 2 rows, and the `Pick one:` line separates it from the three resolved findings, so no preceding items adjoin it. The bare reply `1` falls inside 1-2, so it maps to row 1, "post drafted reply C1", with no echo.
2. **Freshness check.** I run `gh pr view <N> --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,body,baseRefName`. The head, body, state and base all match the record and `consent.target`, so the check passes.
3. **Done-check.** I re-read the drafted C1 reply against the wording rules: ASCII only, specific, and it ends on the fix it points to. It passes.
4. **Post the reply.** I run `gh api --method POST repos/<base-owner>/<base-repo>/pulls/<N>/comments/<C1 comment id>/replies -f body='<drafted C1 reply>'`. It succeeds. I record the new comment id as gate-posted, so it is never minted as a `C#`.
5. **Close.** That was the only mapped step. No repair selection exists, and nothing unpicked runs: no cleanup, branch deletion, base pull, or override steps.
6. **Teardown.** `approved_head` already equals the assessed head. The checkout is left as found. I delete the run record, the helper output files and their logs, and any temporary body files. Unapplied drafts are dropped.

#<N>@<assessed headRefOid>: approved

Checkout: <worktree.path> on local branch <worktree.branch>, left in place.

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=2

## Checkpoint 1

The run starts at the report/menu boundary, so I do not initialize another continuation record or tracker, run verification, or dispatch helpers. I add `report` when integration starts, close it after rendering, and add `menu` when presenting the choices; the assessed SHA remains the existing digest's SHA.

Delivers: The PR makes CSV exports available on demand.
Role: author

PR comments:
- maria's comment concerns the CSV header, so a drafted reply addresses that concern.

Nits:
- The export duplicates the shared paging behavior, so paging fixes would need to be maintained in two places.

Blockers:
1. The export endpoint has no test exercising it, so its behavior can break without detection. (src/api/export.ts:10-58)
2. The export guide says exports run nightly even though the PR makes them on demand, so readers are directed to wait for an operation that no longer exists. (docs/exports.rst:88)
3. The export ignores the requested date range, so it includes records outside the requested period. (src/api/export.ts:60)

Verdict: fixable - 3 blockers

Pick one:
1. assess - post the review to the PR; then approve or stop, no repairs.
2. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
3. deliver with nits - deliver, and fold the paging nit into the repairs.
4. stop - remove the eligible worktree, leave the PR as is.

Course holds until the final menu; `show evidence` prints the full record, including evidence, drafted payloads and replies, and cumulative accounting.

---

## Independent checkpoint 2

This checkpoint starts after approval succeeded, with the persisted menu mapping intact. I do not initialize tracking, reinterpret `1` as a repair selection, or dispatch a helper.

The bare reply `1` selects **post the drafted reply**, not any of the three preceding resolved findings. I record that selection and validate the existing continuation record.

In order, the simulated execution is:

1. I run `gh pr view <N> -R <base-owner>/<base-repo> --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,body,baseRefName`. Freshness passes against the recorded target and approved head.
2. I check the stored reply against the wording rules. The done-check passes.
3. I run `gh api --method POST repos/<base-owner>/<base-repo>/pulls/<N>/comments/<C1.comment_id>/replies --input <temporary-reply-payload-file>`. The input contains only the stored drafted reply, and the post succeeds.
4. I persist the returned comment identity so the gate's own reply is excluded from later comment reconciliation.
5. I remove the run record, helper outputs and logs, finding artifacts if present, and temporary payload files. I leave the checkout and branch unchanged.

The approved run closes without cleanup, repair, push, another approval, or another menu. Its settlement row uses the full approved head:

#<N>@<full-approved-head-sha>: approved

Checkout: <recorded-worktree-path>. Local branch: <recorded-worktree-branch>. Cleanup was not selected.
